design_brief: True crisp BLOCK-PIXEL neon impact matching the reference cyan, magenta, yellow, white palette. Crossed stepped pixel rays and scattered SQUARE pixel sparks, every main contour built from visible right-angle square-grid steps. No smooth vector wings, smooth feather shapes, crown or solid badge. Retro 8-bit geometry rendered sharply at high resolution with localized glow around the block shapes.
limits: This is one combined peak texture; individual particles are not separately controllable within it.
Do not replace or modify frame PNG; keep this on a separate effect layer.
Review material, not a final approved game integration.
Existing frame images may themselves contain quality defects; reference use does not approve them.
